# AURUM S 400W

- Kompatibel mit ATX 12V 2.31 & EPS 12V 2.92 version
- 80 PLUS® GOLD Zertifizierung
- Hohe Effizienz > 90%
- Active PFC > 99%
- +12V Einzelnes Spannungsschienen Schaltungsdesign
- SATA Array Cable Design
- Volle Kabelisolierung
- Multiple PCI-E VGA Power Connectors
- Kompletter Schutz: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP
- Vollste Sicherheit gewährleistet

Die AURUM S Serie ist eine brandneue Netzteil- Serie, die aus qualitativ hochwertigen Komponenten besteht und mehrere eingebaute Sicherheitstechnologien beinhaltet wie, OCP/OVP/SCP/OPP/UVP. Die Netzteilserie Aurum S ist mit 80 PLUS Gold zertifiziert und liefert mehr als 90% Energieeffizienz. Aurum S erfüllt die neusten Vorgaben der ERP 2013 ErP Regulation, welche einen Standby-Stromverbrauch des fertigen Systems von weniger als 0,5 W fordern. Durch die Integration der FSP MIA IC™ Technologie (Multiple Intelligence Ability) , wurde in der AURUM S Serie verschiedene Funktionen kombiniert: PWM (Pulse-width Modulation), ZCS PFC (Nullstromschalter), Post SR, Active-Clamp und Zweikreisschutz vor Überstrom (Double-circuited OVP), außerdem eine verbesserte Struktur der PCB (printed circuit board/ Leiterplatten) für erhebliche Leistungsdichte. Diese Innovation bietet ein Maximum an Schutz.

# AURUM S 400W

- Complies with ATX 12V 2.31 & EPS 12V 2.92 version
- 80 PLUS® GOLD Certification
- High efficiency > 90%
- Active PFC > 99%
- +12V Single Rail Circuit Design
- SATA Array Cable Design
- Full Sleeved Cable
- Multiple PCI-E VGA Power Connectors
- Complete Protections: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP
- Full Safety Approved

 AURUM S 400W 

AURUM S Series – is a brand-new power supply series that is comprised of high-quality components and also carries several power protections OCP/OVP/SCP/OPP/UVP. AURUM S Series meets 80 PLUS® Gold certified with more than 90% power efficiency and compliant with 2013 ErP standard which requires regulations relating to standby power consumption less than 0.5W. With FSP MIA ICTM Technology, AURUM S Series integrated PWM, ZCS PFC, Post SR, and Double-circuited OVP, and improved power PCB structural density. In addition, our unique air flow technology offers a more efficient cooling with less noise. By using special arrow-shaped vents, the AURUM S case design optimized the airflow inside the PSU, and also provides attractive looking. AURUM S Series offers 3 wattages 400W/ 500W/ 600W for the different requirements.

MIA IC TM (Multiple Intelligence Ability) Chip Set

FSP’s own patented designs to provide Ultimate Performance & Highest Protection to your system.

-Constant Hold up control performs continuous adjustments according to the output load in order to achieve the best possible efficiency -PFC Double-circuited Over Voltage Protection (OVP) ensures maximum protection to Capacitor -Zero-Current Switch on PFC ensures minimal energy wasted on switching, Low EMI and low ripple noise contribute to High Efficiency.

Fully compatible with 4th generation Intel Core Series processors

FSP's power supply provide 100% Compatible with Haswell CPUs.

 Unique Air Flow Technology Uniquely designed ventilation holes that allow natural aero dynamics to improve air extraction, keeping your PSU cooler than ever.

+12V Single Rail Design -Designed for power-intensive VGA cards -Provides strong power to any overloading condition

2013 ErP/EuP Ready The total AC power consumption of the completed system is less than 0.5W in standby mode
